dependencyPolicy: Extract named dependency closure from maintained source; Base plus publication.bend. No historical observer or probe module is required.

counterexamples.rejects: Logging overwritten ADTs, or retaining constructor metadata after arbitrary owner replacement
Deferring successful publication across dependent checking

cases.title: Skip repeated canonicalization when private publication state is already canonical
cases.scope: Private publication replay with an authenticated canonical seed and dirty flag; n completed Def updates followed by n ADT updates. Does not replace checking or carry the flag across checker mutations.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: Whole-book reverse, name validation, duplicate selection and reconstruction before each consecutive non-childless publication after the first clean boundary.
cases.charged: Fixture construction, original declaration installation, all index updates, dirty-state records, first required canonicalization, unconditional original final canonicalization, full all-field string observation and ordinary cleanup.
cases.admission: The clean bit is established privately by check_declarations and reset only after canonicalization plus book_put. No arbitrary caller may assert it. Internal checker mutation integration remains unaudited.
cases.negativeControls: Every prefix of mixed replacements, childful Def, Foreign, empty names and full-hash collision names is independently finalized. ADTs are never blindly logged.

cases.title: Batch initial declaration installation with the existing exact overlay helper
cases.scope: Initial declaration installation only, before checking: n independent ADTs and n Def declarations over a disjoint Base-shaped seed. No dependent check or successful-body publication is reordered.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated per-definition outer book insertion/filter transport, replaced by one existing immutable overlay; index_set order is preserved.
cases.charged: Mapping every event through unchanged Foreign/declared choice, retained existing book_put_many admission scans/fallback, complete output observation and cleanup.
cases.priorNegative: Fresh-name cached insertion already avoids index_remove through index_put_rest, so this may add work. Independent successful-definition batching is not justified merely by distinct names: p155p_deferred_type is the concrete counterexample to a broader rule.

cases.title: Reuse constructor membership metadata across append-only successful declaration history
cases.scope: Constructor-name validation component over n unique ADT owner events. Odd n appends a duplicate constructor event and returns the exact successful prefix world plus unchanged first error. This is not full type or dependent checking.
cases.whatWorkDisappears: Repeated whole-event-history constructor_exists scans for each newly declared constructor, replaced by full-name collision-correct indexed membership.
cases.charged: Start with an empty index, insert every successful constructor, retain original local-duplicate list checks and book publication, observe every final world field plus full error, and destroy the auxiliary index.
cases.admission: Unique owner names and successful append-only history; arbitrary replacement/removal and cache-record events require a separate fallback. Do not attach this index to the mutable checker world.
cases.negativeControls: Within-row duplicates, cross-owner duplicates, empty constructor names, and costarring/liquid full-hash collision. Replaced ADT counterexample explicitly prevents stale cache generalization.

measurementLimits: All entries are constructed compiler-shaped component streams. Exact full result strings, no checksum-only correctness gate. No source checking, target execution or performance result was produced by the preparing agent. Phase153 checking/publication total 33.568s is a whole-stage ceiling, not a measured removable fraction or a 20% whole-build opportunity.
